payload.title: LERM applied to synthetic ODP cores
payload.summary: This notebook applies the Linear Empirical Response Model (LERM) to synthetic Ocean Drilling Program (ODP) cores, specifically recreating Figure 3 from a referenced publication. The workflow is similar to that used for Figure 2, with significant variation in data creation using synthetic data. The notebook involves loading and processing data from multiple ODP sites, handling discontinuities, and visualizing results using various plotting libraries.
goals: Recreate Figure 3 from the original publication using synthetic ODP core data.
Apply the Linear Empirical Response Model (LERM) to synthetic data.
Visualize the results of LERM application on synthetic ODP cores.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook focuses on applying LERM to synthetic ODP cores, recreating a specific figure from a publication. It involves data loading, processing, and visualization, with attention to handling data discontinuities and using synthetic data binned for analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: LERM applied to synthetic ODP cores

outputs: Recreated Figure 3 from the original publication
Visualizations of LERM applied to synthetic ODP cores
